newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end at record high but caution prevails.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end at record high but caution prevails.

text.p: UK blue chips surged to a record high for the third day running this week, spurred on by a resilient Wall Street and a more relaxed view about interest rates and stock valuations.
But many institutional investors remained cautious ahead of key U.S. unemployment figures due on Friday which have the potential to burst both the Dow's and the FTSE's bubble.
"The market is nervous. Everybody knows the Dow is going to have a correction," the head of trading at a leading investment bank said.
The FTSE 100 closed 39.2 points higher at 4,399.3.
